default.description: Default capability for the FlowMic main window + capsule HUD (WP-R2-2). core:default covers the event listen/emit surface the frontend bridge uses; app-defined commands (settings/history/capsule) are permitted by default. autostart:default (V2-10) authorizes the plugin's enable/disable/is-enabled surface; the settings page drives it through the app-defined autostart_state/autostart_set commands, which wrap the plugin with fail-loud read-back.
